visualCharacteristics.purpose: Row of video cards: poster image with a play button that loads the video inline, or the player itself when there is no poster; optional heading, quote and CTA below
visualCharacteristics.layout: 1 column mobile; 3 cards: 3 in a row from 600px; 2 or 4 cards: 2 in a row from 600px, 4 cards 4 in a row from 900px; 16:9 media (9:16 with portrait)

contentPattern.structure: cell 1: optional poster image; cell 2: the video link (YouTube, Vimeo, videomarketingplatform.co .thtml, Dynamic Media /is/content/ or .mp4) plus optional heading, text/quote and a CTA link (a link alone in its paragraph). The video link text becomes the play button / player accessible label
contentPattern.sourceDescription: Three look-alike illustrated video items in a row (poster + Dynamic Media video link each)

usage: Small-wins video row on the home page.
reuseGuidance: Use for any group of videos with posters. Without a recognised video link the card renders as an image card.
